_use: Paste BLOCKS verbatim where a prompt says +STYLE/+INDONESIA/+PEOPLE/+EXCLUDE. Record the exact submitted text, model id/version, refs, seed and date in asset-manifest.json runs[] at generation time. Generate every still one aspect looser than its crop (3:4 -> 4:5, 3:2 -> 16:9, 16:9 -> 21:9 band) so a corner badge, if any, is cropped away.

blocks.STYLE: Editorial documentary photograph for an Indonesian newspaper weekend edition. 35mm lens, natural perspective, no wide-angle distortion. Kodak Portra 400 colour rendition, natural skin texture with visible pores and slight unevenness, everyday clothes with creases, real everyday clutter, weathered surfaces, no retouching, no beauty lighting, humid tropical air.
blocks.INDONESIA: Indonesian realism: ruko shophouses with steel rolling shutters; terrazzo or plain ceramic floor tiles; terracotta roof tiles or corrugated sheets; a galon water dispenser; rattan or plastic chairs; round-pin C/F wall sockets; unbranded matic scooters, parked and driven on the LEFT side of the road (left-hand traffic); tangled overhead power lines; tropical plants (monstera, sansevieria, pucuk merah) in plastic pots.
blocks.PEOPLE: People are anonymous: back turned, in profile or mid-action; faces small in frame or not visible; nobody looks at the camera or poses; hands are natural and busy with the task.
blocks.EXCLUDE: No readable text or letters anywhere (signs, labels, packaging, screens, licence plates, clothing prints). No logos or brand marks. No watermarks. No visible screen content: phones, tablets and laptops face down, angled away or dark. No Gojek or Grab jackets or colours, no QRIS standees, no Monas or other landmarks, no right-hand traffic, no US-style sockets, no snow or autumn leaves, no ring light, no studio backdrop, no HDR look, no teal-and-orange grade, no oversaturated greens, no bokeh balls, no lens flare.

P1.text: [SHOT] Editorial documentary photo, 35mm, f/5.6, locked-off tripod view from a 5th-floor rooftop looking north, slight downward angle, horizon on the upper third. [SUBJECT] Rooftops of a dense ruko neighbourhood in Tebet, Jakarta Selatan: blue and sun-faded grey plastic water tanks on steel stands, satellite dishes, clotheslines with batik shirts and white school uniforms, terracotta roof tiles and corrugated sheets, tangled power lines, a green mosque dome with one slim white minaret just right of centre (about 52% from the left edge), a curving elevated toll road crossing the middle distance from left to right, mid-rise apartment towers fading into haze on the horizon. Street level, lower right (about 70-85% from the left edge, above the bottom band): a small kedai with a coral awning and a half-raised steel rolling shutter, two unbranded scooters parked on the left side of the street. [LIGHT] 07.00 WIB, low morning sun from frame right (east), long soft shadows falling to the left, humid haze. [SKY] Plain, evenly lit pale blue-grey sky with no clouds, birds, aircraft, sun disc or flare, cleanly separable from the skyline for masking. [BRAND] The coral awning is the only saturated red, pink, magenta or orange object in the frame (no orange water tanks). [FRAME] 3:2; keep the bottom 16% plain concrete of our own rooftop parapet, it will be cropped. [REALISM] Kodak Portra 400, real power lines, everyday clutter, weathered paint and water stains. +INDONESIA +EXCLUDE

P3.text: Build one deterministic 1280x720 HTML/CSS scene for Logink, driven only by a CSS custom property --p from 0 to 1 on :root. No randomness, no timers, no CSS animations, no JS except an optional window.setP(p). Every layer is an absolutely positioned 1280x720 or SVG. Layers bottom to top: (1) four sky plates crossfading piecewise: langit-0700 at --p 0, langit-1240 at .333, langit-1805 at .667, langit-2130 at 1 (each adjacent pair crossfades linearly across its segment). (2) four city plates with the sky cut out (PNG alpha), crossfading the same way: day 0 -> noon .333 -> dusk .667 -> night 1; the night plate reaches full opacity by --p .95. (3) window-light layer, mix-blend-mode: screen, opacity 0 until --p .62 then 1 by .9. (4) haze: a linear-gradient screen layer from the horizon line (y about 240px) downward to 45% of the height, rgba(255,255,255,.35) at the horizon to 0, opacity peaking at 1 around --p .333 and 0 by .15 and .5. (5) traffic streaks: an SVG path traced over the toll road; after --p .7 draw 6-8 short blurred dash groups with stroke-dashoffset = f(--p): warm white headlights in the far lane moving left to right, red tail-lights in the near lane moving right to left (left-hand traffic), stroke 2-3px, filter blur 1px. No text, no UI, no logos anywhere. All images decoded before the first frame. Deliver the HTML plus its image folder; frames are rendered at --n=25 (8 per segment; stage keyframes land on frames 1, 9, 17, 25) with --dsf=2.

P4a.text: [SHOT] Editorial documentary photo, 35mm, eye-level wide shot down a quiet ruko street in Tebet, Jakarta Selatan at 05.40 WIB first light, locked-off. [SUBJECT] Small in the frame at the right (about 62-88% from the left edge), back half-turned, a Betawi woman in her 40s in a sage hijab and a denim shirt arranges clear glass kerupuk jars with plain aluminium lids on the counter of her half-open kedai (steel rolling shutter half up, coral awning). A steel kettle steams on a gas stove inside. A phone lies face-down on the counter. One unbranded scooter is parked on the left side of the road. [LIGHT] Civil twilight: overnight-rain puddles on the asphalt reflect a pale pink-lilac sky; sodium street lamps still on; no direct sun. [BRAND] The coral awning is the only saturated red, pink, magenta or orange object. [FRAME] 16:9; keep all action inside the central horizontal band between 12% and 88% of the height (the top 12% is plain sky, the bottom 12% plain wet asphalt; both are cropped for the 21:9 film). Calm open asphalt and sky across the left 45%. [REALISM] Kodak Portra 400, natural skin texture, no retouching. +INDONESIA +PEOPLE +EXCLUDE

P4b.text: Image-to-video from the reference still. 8 seconds, 24 fps. Locked-off tripod camera with a very slow push-in of at most 3% across the whole clip; no pan, no tilt, no shake. Motion only: thin steam rises from the kettle inside the kedai; the woman moves slowly behind the counter arranging jars, back half-turned, her face never turns toward the camera and is never shown close; one unbranded scooter with its headlight on passes far in the background from left to right on the left side of the road; at about 5 seconds the nearest sodium street lamp switches off; at about 6 seconds the face-down phone on the counter glows softly at its edges; puddle reflections ripple faintly. Nothing new enters the frame. No text, signs or logos appear. No speech, no lip movement, no music. The last frame returns to the composition of the first frame.

briefs_claude_design._common: Ship as a React Server Component + CSS (no client JS unless stated). Tokens from final.md; panels radius 0 (frames 4px), 1px hairlines rgba(20,18,27,.12) on light / rgba(244,241,247,.14) on dark; label 'ILUSTRASI · DATA CONTOH' / 'ILLUSTRATION · SAMPLE DATA' top-left in Archivo wdth 125 wght 600 12px +0.12em; wrapper data-nosnippet; all text server-rendered from an ID/EN copy map; motion only when the section gets [data-in] from RevealObserver, transform/opacity only, one-shot, stagger <= 6 items, reduced-motion = final state; no third-party logos or chrome, no 'Live' badges, no dates or clock stamps inside mocks; fictional entities only (Kedai Contoh, contohkedai.id, Brand A/B/C); text on flat token surfaces only; crisp at DPR 3 and at 320px width.
